title: Whole recorded plant scenes · FX10 and FX17
scope: Every recorded pixel in both run003 spectral cubes, including background and references. Camera-visible scene coverage is not all physical leaf surfaces.
coordinate_convention: Display x = native scan line; display y = columns - 1 - native detector column. Zero-based indices.
row_encoding: gzip(column_delta_uint16_mod65536_byte_planes); uncompressed low bytes then high bytes of [column,band]; first column absolute; subsequent columns differences from preceding column.

normalization.white_identity: User-confirmed white board at scan start; spectral reflectance unknown
normalization.settings_assumption: User confirmed fixed exposure; gain and source export packing not independently established
normalization.dark_provenance: Abrupt final low-signal tail; shutter closure unconfirmed. This is an explicit assumed offset, not certified dark calibration.
